pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Dark brown regions exhibit irregular, jagged polygonal geometries with prominent angular projections. The edges show a soft pixel gradient due to image blur, but the primary structure consists of complex, non-smooth perimeters.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous, light-tan topological graph of narrow pathways. The network features clear junction nodes with predominantly tri-radial intersections. Thickness is relatively uniform throughout the visible flank and neck area.
